descLanding: Self-declaration system for brokerage firms to record and manage customer risk records. Each brokerage manages its own case files; cross-brokerage discovery is limited to the search inquiry.
descCases: Case files registered by your brokerage. Files cannot be deleted — only archived.
descNewCase: Create a new risk case file. Once submitted it is owned by your brokerage and remains visible to others only through the search inquiry view.
descCaseDetail: Edit, update or archive an existing risk case file.
descSearch: Inquire on risk case files registered by all brokerages. Results show only the limited fields permitted by the access policy.
descSearchDetail: Cross-brokerage view — fields shown here are limited per the access policy. To see the full record, contact the owning brokerage.
descAuditLog: Activity log for your brokerage — logins, case-file actions, search inquiries and admin changes.
descAdminUsers: Manage users authorised to access this brokerage's case files. Roles: Admin (manages users + IPs), Operator (creates/edits cases), Viewer (search only).
descAdminIps: Manage the IP whitelist for this brokerage. Access from any IP not on this list will be refused once enforcement is enabled by the operator.
descAdminSecurity: Security posture summary — controls implemented in the system, recommended next steps, and items pending in the development roadmap.
actingBrokerageHint: Switch which brokerage you are acting as. The list of your cases, audit log and admin pages all reflect this brokerage.
tcBody1: The Customer Risk System is a self-declaration tool — information stored here is informational only and is not the basis for legal, regulatory or final decisions.
tcBody2: Responsibility for the accuracy of the information lies with the recording brokerage. The Association of Brokers acts only as the infrastructure provider.
tcBody3: Cross-brokerage information exchange beyond the search inquiry view requires formal authorisation.
tcAccepted: I have read and accept the terms and regulations.
relatedPersonsHint: Family members, business partners, legal representatives or anyone with a material connection. All fields are optional.
hasAnyOtherRisks: There are other risks to record
validationIndividualFields: Individual customers require date of birth and father's name.
validationRiskState: Pick a state for both Credit Risk and Documents Risk.
searchPlaceholder: Search: case #, name, national ID, stock code (customer & related persons)
auditSearchPlaceholder: Search: action, user, IP, resource, details
confirmArchive: After archiving, this case leaves My Cases and moves to your Archive page, where you can still view it (read-only).
confirmIpDelete: Remove this IP from the whitelist?
searchNoResults: No case files match these filters.
redactedBanner: Cross-brokerage inquiry view. Only fields permitted by the access policy are shown. Descriptions and amounts are hidden — contact the owning brokerage if you need them.
auditNoEntries: No audit entries match the current filters.
noUsers: No users defined for this brokerage yet.
noIps: No IPs whitelisted for this brokerage yet.
securityItemAudit: Full audit log of user activity
securityItemEncryption: Sensitive-field encryption at the database layer
securityItemAuditTrail: Field-level audit trail of case changes
validationNationalIdLength: National ID must be exactly 10 digits.
validationLegalIdLength: Legal entity ID must be exactly 11 digits.
personLinked: Linked to an existing person record.
personCreated: Customer saved to the Person service.
personDuplicateOutOfScope: This national ID already exists in the system but is not visible in your company. The case was filed without a person link.
personLinkFailed: Could not reach the Person service. The case was filed without a person link.
